Lina Torres: Auditor wants reproducible evidence for the emergency KMS rotation tied to CVE-2025-1122. Scope: prod account 123456789012, window 2025-11-29 -> 2025-12-02. Ask: full CloudTrail/KMS events, IAM diffs for service account deprovision, approval logs, key-policy snapshots, and a signed attestation. Can someone own packaging and include a replay script?

Ravi Kapoor: I can pull CloudTrail and export relevant KMS events (EnableKeyRotation, DisableKeyRotation, ScheduleKeyDeletion, GenerateDataKey, Decrypt). Ill include exact AWS CLI commands and the raw JSON events. Region us-west-2, account 123456789012.

Jordan Bly: Ill create the RBAC change CSV from the IAM change-store: fields (chg_id, actor, target, pre_bindings, post_bindings, ticket). Will scrub personal emails and include a redaction map file so auditor can resolve if needed.

Auditor - PwC: Need event -> principal -> key_arn -> timestamp mapping and proof that deprovisioned principal could not decrypt post-rotation. Also require the key policy before/after and an attestation PDF. The package must be reproducible; include a replay_check.sh.

Ravi Kapoor: Plan: export events with CloudTrail lookup and CloudWatch Logs Insights for KMS control-plane. Example CLI: `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventSource,AttributeValue=kms.amazonaws.com --start-time 2025-11-29T00:00:00Z --end-time 2025-12-02T23:59:59Z --query Events[*].CloudTrailEvent`. Ill produce `cloudtrail/events.json` and a small CSV `cloudtrail/index.csv` mapping eventId -> principal -> eventTime -> resource.

Jordan Bly: For deprov proof Ill run an impersonation test and capture the AccessDenied CloudTrail event. Command: `aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/deprov-svc-role --role-session-name audit-check` then attempt decrypt. Ill include raw failure event JSON and the requestParameters.keyId.

Lina Torres: Include rotation run id rot-20251130-13 from infra automation and the ticket INC-9910. Also ensure S3 object lock on the final tar and include the put-object response headers in manifest.

Ravi Kapoor: evidence-bot: start snapshot job for account 123456789012 (job: ev-1747703210).

evidence-bot: snapshot job ev-1747703210 started.

Ravi Kapoor: Uploaded snapshot to s3://redwood-evidence/prod/ev-1747703210.tar.gz (sha256: 9b7f...). Included directories: cloudtrail/, kms_policies/, iam_diffs/, tickets/, scripts/, manifests/. replay_check.sh validates sha256 and re-runs read-only CloudTrail lookup.

Jordan Bly: Approval metadata: INC-9910 shows approvals by "Ravi Kapoor (SecOps)" 2025-11-30T01:12:08Z and "Lina Torres (CISO)" 2025-11-30T01:25:40Z. Ill attach the PDF attestation signed by SecOps and the cover letter.

Auditor - PwC: Received. Please confirm the CloudTrail eventId for the failed decrypt so we can verify the replay. Also confirm what redactions were applied.

Jordan Bly: Failed decrypt eventId 'b1e6f3c2-2025-12-01T05:22:17Z' (file: cloudtrail/errors/b1e6f3c2.json). Redactions: replaced user emails with initials in iam_diffs/; principal ARNs and key ARNs left intact. Redaction map at tickets/redactions.md.

Lina Torres: Ill produce the control matrix mapping artifacts to SOC2 CC6 and ISO A.9 and upload the one-page cover letter. Marking this done; well be ready for a remote replay session on your schedule. :thumbsup:
